sovereign_country.strategic_role: 制造业产业链转移第一站、保税加工（EPE）设立首选

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Income-Generating Real Estate Property Portfolio Trust (REIT)

meta_jurisdiction_context.sovereign_country_en: Socialist Republic of Viet Nam (Viet Nam)
meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Viet Nam (Socialist Republic of Viet Nam) — unitary national jurisdiction; no separate sub-state corporate registry; central licensing via provincial Departments of Planning and Investment and national ministries
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — Civil Law code-based system with socialist legal doctrine; unitary hierarchy

ASEAN–Australia–New Zealand Free Trade Agreement (AANZFTA), in force since 2010

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15 (in force 01 Dec 2022), as implemented by Decree No. 19/2023/NĐ-CP and Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN of the State Bank of Viet Nam (SBV), together with the SBV-led Financial Intelligence Unit (Anti-Money Laundering Center). Beneficial-owner and shareholder transparency is also governed by the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14, the Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, Decree No. 01/2021/NĐ-CP and Circular No. 04/2021/TT-BKHĐT on enterprise registration, and Decree No. 31/2021/NĐ-CP on investment registration. For the real-estate trust scope, the Law on Real Estate Business No. 29/2023/QH15 (in force 01 Aug 2024) conditions licensing on disclosure of shareholder and beneficial ownership information to the licensing authority.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Business Registration Certificate of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry of the investor's home jurisdiction (e.g., ACRA, Companies House, Secretary of State office)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Viet Nam acceded to the Hague Apostille Convention of 05 Oct 1961; Convention in force for Viet Nam since 01 Feb 2020), or full consular legalization at a Vietnamese diplomatic/consular post if the issuer is not an Apostille Party

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Constitutional charter / Memorandum and Articles of Association of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-jurisdiction registry or notary public authenticated by the registry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization route set out above; Vietnamese notarized translation and sworn translation certification in Viet Nam

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution of the foreign corporate shareholder authorizing the incorporation of the Viet Nam LLC and committing to charter-capital fund transfer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the foreign shareholder, notarized in the home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; Vietnamese notarized translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport / national-identification true copies of each UBO, the proposed legal representative, and all officers of the Viet Nam LLC
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority of each individual and the home notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized true copies in the country of origin, then Hague Apostille or consular legalization; identity copies must postdate the application by not more than 90 days

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming source of funds for the initial charter capital contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed foreign correspondent bank where the foreign shareholder maintains its operating account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank letter on official letterhead notarized and apostilled (or consular legalized) and localized by Vietnamese notarized translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney to the local Vietnamese incorporation agent or law firm (if the foreign shareholder will not appear in person)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign shareholder and home-jurisdiction notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; Vietnamese notarized translation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (Articles 22, 26, 32, 47, 51) jointly with Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 (Articles 33-38); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on Enterprise Registration (as amended by Decree No. 70/2023/ND-CP); Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP on Investment Registration; Law on Real Estate Business No. 29/2023/QH14 (Articles 8, 26) and Decree No. 96/2024/ND-CP; Securities Law No. 54/2019/QH14 and Decree No. 128/2021/ND-CP
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province or centrally governed city where the registered office and underlying real property are situated (e.g., DPI of Ho Chi Minh City); operating under the Ministry of Planning and Investment (MPI); electronic submission via the National Enterprise Registration Portal at dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn and the National Foreign Investment Registration system
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Investment Registration Certificate application (Form A.I-4/A.I-5) and Enterprise Registration Certificate application (Form III-1) together with the Company Charter (Điều lệ công ty), the list of members and capital contribution statements (Form III-8/III-9), and, for the REIT scope, the securities offering and fund licensing dossiers under Decree 128/2021/ND-CP
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: As the entity is engaged in the conditional real estate business, the charter capital must be at least VND 20,000,000,000 (approx. USD 850,000) before commencing activities, per Article 8 of Law on Real Estate Business No. 29/2023/QH14. A foreign investor must open a Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) with a licensed commercial bank in Vietnam and remit the subscribed capital into Vietnam; the charter capital must be fully contributed within 90 days of issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate under Article 47 of the Law on Enterprises. Any customer deposit or advance payment in respect of the income-generating real estate portfolio must be placed in a statutory escrow account at a permitted commercial bank in accordance with Article 26 of Law No. 29/2023/QH14 and Decree No. 96/2024/ND-CP.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE GENERAL MEETING OF MEMBERS OF VN REIT HOLDINGS LLC. Adoption by unanimous written consent in accordance with Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14. 1. RESOLVED, that the Company be and is hereby established as a limited liability company, and that the registered office be and is hereby adopted at Suite [X], [Commercial Tower], [Street], [Ward/District], [Province/City], Vietnam; 2. RESOLVED, that the charter capital of the Company be and is hereby fixed at VND 20,000,000,000 (twenty billion Vietnamese Dong), subscribed fully in cash by the Founding Members as set forth in the Company Charter; RESOLVED FURTHER, that the General Director be and is hereby authorized to open a Direct Investment Capital Account in the name of the Company at [Bank], to receive the contribution of charter capital, and to apply for the statutory escrow account instruments required for real estate trading; 3. RESOLVED, that the office of Chairman of the Members' Council be and is hereby conferred on [Member A], the office of General Director on [Name], the office of Chief Financial Officer on [Name], and the office of Compliance and Tax Officer on [Name], each of whom is vested with full authority to execute and file the Investment Registration Certificate, Enterprise Registration Certificate, tax registration, corporate seal registration, banking resolutions, and any salvage or curative filings; 4. RESOLVED, that the Company apply for and obtain the Real Estate Business Eligibility Certification, the Real Estate Investment Trust fund license or registration with the State Securities Commission, the environmental registration and fire safety acceptance certificate, and all consents necessary to own and lease income-generating real property in Vietnam; 5. RESOLVED, that all public filings and fee payments be made through the National Enterprise Registration Portal, and that the Company publish its establishment notice in accordance with Article 32 of the Law on Enterprises within 30 days; 6. RESOLVED, that any one of the General Director, the Chairman, or the Compliance Officer may certify true copies of this resolution. This Resolution takes effect immediately upon adoption on [date].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) for the Foreign-Invested Project
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province where the real estate project is located; or the Management Board of Industrial Parks/Export Processing Zones/High-Tech Parks if the project is implemented inside such zone; online filing through the National Investment Registration Portal administered by MPI
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Investment Registration dossier in Vietnamese and transmit it electronically or directly to the receiving DPI/Management Board. The dossier must state the REIT activity under ISIC 6499/NAICS 525930 and identify the underlying income-generating real property. The DPI verifies the legal status and financial capacity of the foreign shareholders, the proposed capital contribution schedule, and compliance with land and real estate regulations. Upon satisfactory appraisal, the DPI issues the IRC which fixes the investment project code, licensed activity, charter capital, and implementation schedule. The IRC must be obtained before the enterprise registration application is made. Legalization of foreign corporate documents and Vietnamese translation/notarization are prerequisites.
required_dossiers: Application for Investment Registration Certificate (Form A.I-4 of Decree 31/2021/ND-CP)
Investment Project Proposal (Form A.I-5) containing the REIT business plan and financial projections
Draft Company Charter of the proposed LLC
Certified copy of the foreign shareholder's certificate of incorporation/registration and passport of ultimate beneficial owners
Recent audited financial statements or bank confirmation evidencing the financial capacity of each foreign investor
Power of attorney designating the project representative in Vietnam
Legal evidence of right to use the underlying land and buildings (land-use right certificate / 'red book' or lease agreement)
Opinions of sectoral agencies if required for conditional sectors (e.g., State Securities Commission on REIT structure)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI sends a request for supplementation, the investor has a maximum of 10 working days from the request to cure the dossier; failure to do so results in rejection or return of the dossier. The investor may re-file without penalty. A refusal must be in writing; the investor may lodge a first-instance administrative complaint with the DPI or the Chief Inspector of MPI within 90 days under Administrative Law No. 24/2019/QH10, and thereafter initiate administrative court proceedings at the competent provincial court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the Enterprise and Obtain the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Enterprise Registration Division of the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) in the province of the registered office; online via the National Enterprise Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) using a digital signature certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the IRC is granted, submit the Enterprise Registration dossier to the DPI. The DPI automatically issues a tax identification number together with the ERC. The legal representative's identity papers, the Company Charter, and the members' capital contribution schedule must be notarized or certified by a Vietnamese notary public. If the dossier is valid, the ERC is issued within 3 working days. After the ERC, the company must publish the notice of establishment on the National Enterprise Registration Portal within 30 days and register the corporate seal. The ERC finalizes the legal existence of the LLC and the scope of activity includes real estate investment trust and leasing.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration (Form III-1 of Decree 01/2021/ND-CP)
Company Charter approved by all founding members
List of members (Form III-8) and contribution statement (Form III-9)
Certified copies of legal identification of members (passport or overseas corporate registration)
Notarized legalization of foreign documents
Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) already obtained for the project
Power of attorney for the authorized applicant
Anti-Money Laundering beneficial ownership declaration where the members are institutional trustees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The DPI issues a reasoned refusal notice or a request for correction. The applicant may correct and resubmit within the remaining term or, if the term has expired, re-submit as a new dossier without additional state fee. An administrative appeal may be lodged with the Director of DPI within 90 days of refusal, and subsequent judicial review is available at the provincial administrative court. In parallel, the enterprise should monitor the online portal status and use its assigned reference code to track the file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Formalities: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA), Charter Capital Contribution, Corporate Seal, Tax Registration and Publication
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial banks in Vietnam (for DICA and escrow), Tax Sub-Department of the province (automatic tax code under the ERC), Ministry of Public Security through online seal registration, and the DPI portal for publication
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) in the name of the LLC at an authorized commercial bank; the foreign members remit the subscribed charter capital into the DICA strictly within 90 days of ERC issuance. The company must then convert forex into VND and file a capital contribution receipt with the DPI/tax authority. If the real estate trust will take deposits from customers or co-investors, open the statutory escrow accounts under Decree 96/2024/ND-CP. Register the corporate seal via the National Enterprise Registration Portal; the seal registration is automatically communicated to the police and tax agencies. Publish the establishment notice on the portal within 30 days, purchase and install an electronic invoicing system, and, if ten or more employees, register the labour usage and open an account at the provincial social insurance agency.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate and Company Charter
Investment Registration Certificate
Resolution of Members on the DICA officer and authorized signatories
Bank account opening application template issued by the commercial bank
Certificate of incorporation/legal identity of the foreign members and passport of UBOs
Capital contribution schedule and remittance instruction to the DICA
Seal registration form and seal specimen (digital seal is permissible under Decree 01/2021/ND-CP)
Establishment notice form for publication (Article 32, Law on Enterprises)
Tax registration update (Form 08-DK-TCT) if additional tax obligations apply
AML/KYC documents required by the bank (beneficial ownership declaration, business purpose statement for the REIT)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the commercial bank rejects the DICA application due to KYC/AML deficiencies, the LLC must remedy the beneficial ownership evidence or select another licensed bank; the bank's refusal is not a state act and is subject to private contract remedy. If charter capital is not contributed within 90 days, the members lose unperformed contribution rights and may be subject to administrative fines under Decree 47/2021/ND-CP; cure consists of immediate contribution, filing an updated contribution record, and paying the penalty. Delays in publication may be cured by late publishing; the DPI may impose a fine but the corporate existence remains valid.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Real Estate Business Eligibility and REIT Fund License / Registration with the State Securities Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Securities Commission (SSC) of the Ministry of Finance for the Real Estate Investment Trust fund license and any offering/listing approvals; provincial Department of Construction for the Real Estate Business Eligibility Certificate under Decree No. 96/2024/ND-CP implementing Law No. 29/2023/QH14
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: As the LLC operates as an income-generating real estate portfolio trust, it must satisfy the general real estate business conditions and the securities/trust regime. Submit the Real Estate Business Eligibility dossier to the Department of Construction (or Provincial People's Committee where required) proving charter capital of at least VND 20 billion, an organizational chart with qualified personnel, and lawful title to the underlying properties. For the REIT dimension, submit a licensing dossier to the SSC for the establishment and operation of a real estate investment trust fund under Securities Law No. 54/2019/QH14 and Decree No. 128/2021/ND-CP, including a fund charter, a prospectus/operation plan, a custodian bank agreement, and an AML compliance manual. Where the LLC will not publicly offer fund certificates, a simplified fund registration may apply; the SSC must nonetheless approve the REIT as a closed-ended fund. The escrow account for customer deposits, the DICA for foreign capital, and an independent custodian arrangement must be in place before operating.
required_dossiers: Application form for Real Estate Business Eligibility (Form under Decree 96/2024/ND-CP)
Charter showing registered charter capital of at least VND 20,000,000,000 and proof of contribution (bank remittance certificates or audit report)
Land-use right certificates ('red books') and construction completion certificates for all properties in the trust portfolio
Enterprise Registration Certificate and Investment Registration Certificate covering the REIT activity
REIT Fund Establishment License application to the SSC, including fund charter, fund management rules, investment policy, and risk disclosures
Draft prospectus/offering document if the fund certificates are to be placed with institutional investors
Agreement with a licensed custodian bank for asset custody and cash-flow monitoring
Escrow account agreement with a commercial bank for customer advances/deposits
AML compliance program and beneficial ownership register in line with Law No. 18/2022/QH14
Appointment certificates of the General Director, Compliance Officer, and fund supervisor
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the SSC or the Department of Construction requests corrections, the applicant must submit supplemental documents within 10 working days of the notice; extension to 30 days can be requested on justified grounds. A denial must be reasoned in writing and may be appealed to the Minister of Finance (for SSC decisions) or the Chair of the Provincial People's Committee (for construction decisions), with judicial review available. If the denial relates to insufficient capital or defective property titles, the company may increase charter capital or replace the asset portfolio and submit a new application, as cure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial, Physical and Environmental Licensing: Fire Safety Acceptance, Environmental Registration / EIA, Construction Completion and Occupational Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Fire Prevention and Rescue Police Department (under the Provincial Police); Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) or MONRE as applicable; provincial Department of Construction for construction completion certificates; Department of Labour, Invalids and Social Affairs for occupational safety
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before the REIT can lease out the held properties, conduct a pre-commissioning inspection of fire prevention systems: submit the approved fire protection design, arrange installation by a licensed contractor, and request the Fire Police to carry out acceptance testing, issuing the Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate (văn bản chấp thuận nghiệm thu về PCCC). For environmental compliance, file the Environmental Registration with the DONRE under Decree 08/2022/ND-CP if the property portfolio is an existing, operating building; if any new construction is involved or if the aggregate floor area exceeds thresholds, prepare a full Environmental Impact Assessment report and obtain an Environmental Permit. For buildings constructed by third parties, obtain the formal operation certificate / hồ sơ hoàn công. Submit the occupational safety self-assessment and emergency response plan to the labour authority if the LLC has direct employees; tenant workplaces remain under tenant responsibility, but the owner must ensure common areas comply with fire codes and obtain occupational clearance.
required_dossiers: Fire protection design approval file and installation acceptance protocol (PCCC)
Completed fire safety acceptance test certificate issued by Fire Police
Environmental Registration form (Form 1 of Annex II, Decree 08/2022/ND-CP) or the full EIA report and Environmental Permit in the case of new construction or larger-scale operation
Wastewater, solid waste, and hazardous waste management plans with stated volumes and discharge points
Construction completion certificate / operation certificate (hồ sơ hoàn công) for each property from the Department of Construction
Structural load inspection reports and energy/building certifications if applicable
Occupational safety risk assessment and health surveillance plan
Records of fire drills, emergency exits, lightning protection, and elevator/equipment inspection certificates
Certificate of eligibility of the maintenance contractor for MEP systems
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DONRE refuses the environmental registration, the company may supplement the waste-disposal contracts and discharge measurements and resubmit; administrative appeal lies to the MONRE and administrative court. If Fire Police issue a notice of non-acceptance, the company must rectify deficiencies, re-test through a licensed inspection organization, and request a new acceptance inspection; operation cannot recommence until the certificate is issued. Missing hồ sơ hoàn công can be cured by retroactive construction verification through the Building Investication Unit of the Department of Construction, followed by a new acceptance procedure.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: State Securities Commission (SSC) of the Ministry of Finance for the Real Estate Investment Trust fund license and securities filings; provincial Department of Construction under the Ministry of Construction for the Real Estate Business Eligibility Certificate and construction completion; provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) under MONRE for environmental registration/EIA
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Certificate of Real Estate Business Eligibility (Decree No. 96/2024/ND-CP implementing Law on Real Estate Business No. 29/2023/QH14) and Establishment and Operation License of the Real Estate Investment Trust Fund under Securities Law No. 54/2019/QH14 and Decree No. 128/2021/ND-CP

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE); decentralized to the provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) for projects under the State's delegated thresholds
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: For a REIT acquiring and leasing existing income-generating real estate (without substantial new construction), the classification is 'Category III – Environmental Registration' (đăng ký môi trường) which requires a passive registration rather than a full EIA. A 'Category I/II – Full Environmental Impact Assessment Report plus Environmental Permit' is triggered if the project involves construction of a new building complex with floor area over 5,000 m2, project land area over 1 ha, or daily wastewater discharge of 100 m3/day or more, in line with Annex II of Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP. Because the REIT's underlying assets are existing rental properties, the registration tier applies unless refurbishment or redevelopment pushes the project into the higher category.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharged by tenants and common facilities must meet QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT (domestic wastewater) at the boundary of the premises if discharged to an internal receiving body, or QCVN 24:2009/BTNMT for connection to centralized industrial zones; atmospheric emissions from standby generators and boiler systems must satisfy QCVN 19:2009/BTNMT and QCVN 20:2009/BTNMT (industrial emissions) with particulate thresholds of 200 mg/Nm3 and SO2 of 500 mg/Nm3 for permitted systems; indoor air quality in occupied spaces must comply with QCVN 02:2019/BYT (VOC, formaldehyde, CO2, PM10 within 0.05-0.3 ppm occupational exposure limits); hazardous waste (paint residues, e-waste, cleaning solvents, fluorescent bulbs) must be stored in labeled leak-proof containers, manifested, and transported only by MONRE-licensed waste operators; waste disposal records must be retained for five years; environmental monitoring reports are submitted semi-annually under Circular 02/2022/TT-BTNMT.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety approval and acceptance certificate issued by the Fire Prevention and Rescue Police Department under Law on Fire Prevention and Fighting No. 27/2001/QH10 as amended by Law No. 40/2013/QH11, mandatory before the buildings are occupied or leased; includes verification of fire alarms, sprinklers, extinguishers, emergency exits, and assembly-point plans. Structural load and construction completion clearance is granted through the hồ sơ hoàn công (as-built file) and operation certificate issued by the provincial Department of Construction, proving that the building satisfies design loads, wind/seismic resistance, and accessibility codes. Occupational clearance requires workplace risk assessments, engineering controls, personal protective equipment, emergency evacuation drills, and health surveillance under Law on Occupational Safety and Health No. 84/2015/QH14, with periodic inspections by the provincial Inspectorate of Labour and mandatory registration of equipment under Circular No. 06/2020/TT-BLDTBXH.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (GDT, Tổng cục Thuế) under the Ministry of Finance of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. Electronic tax administration portal: https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn (e-filing, e-payment, e-refund); national e-invoice clearance portal: https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn; national enterprise registration and TIN issuance portal: https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Obtain a real estate/REIT statutory license as required by the Law on Real Estate Business 29/2023/QH15 (and securities licensing if publicly offered) and secure the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) from the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) under the Law on Investment 61/2020/QH14 for the foreign-invested LLC. Step 2: Submit the enterprise registration application online at https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn; the DPI issues the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) within 3 working days, and the 13-digit Enterprise Tax Identification Number (MST) is automatically generated and printed on the ERC. Step 3: Tax registration becomes effective automatically with the ERC; the taxpayer then activates the e-tax account on https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn, obtains a digital signature certificate (eCA token), and submits the VAT-method election and tax registration confirmation dossier (Form 04/ĐK-TCT) within 10 working days. VAT registration is integrated with the ERC; no separate VAT registration exercise exists. Step 4: A foreign entity not establishing a Vietnamese entity but earning Vietnamese-source income (e.g., a foreign asset manager or offshore REIT promoter) must apply separately for a Foreign Contractor Tax (FCT) TIN at the competent GDT sub-department within 5 working days (Form 04/ĐK-TCT), and if operating through a branch/permanent establishment, obtain a local tax file under Circular 80/2021/TT-BTC. Step 5: Open a foreign-currency account at a licensed Vietnamese commercial bank for export/leasing proceeds, and register the e-invoice solution and digital signing mechanism with the GDT before the first invoice is issued.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the Foreign-Invested LLC is a resident tax enterprise under Article 2 of the Law on Corporate Income Tax (CIT) No. 14/2008/QH12, as amended (Law 32/2013/QH13 and Law 71/2014/QH13) and Decree 218/2013/ND-CP, and is taxed at the entity level at the flat 20% CIT rate on worldwide income. No pass-through or REIT-specific tax transparency is recognized under Vietnamese law; profit distributions are made from after-tax profits and dividends remitted abroad by a foreign corporate investor are not subject to Vietnamese dividend withholding tax (domestic law imposes no dividend WHT). Territorial scope: Vietnam operates a worldwide CIT system with a unilateral foreign tax credit for foreign-source income under Circular 80/2021/TT-BTC and available double-tax-treaty relief. Tax-exempt-zone treatment is limited to licensed export-processing enterprises (EPEs) and designated high-tech/economic zones and is inapplicable to a domestic real-estate portfolio REIT. No sub-national income taxes exist; the tax system is unitary at the national level.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vietnam does not provide U.S.-style check-the-box or entity-classification elections. Available statutory elections and regimes for the VN LLC REIT include: (i) VAT method election — the LLC may elect the input-credit (deduction) method versus the direct method (3% or 5% deemed turnover tax) under the Law on VAT, subject to GDT registration; a foreign-invested LLC generally must adopt the credit method upon registration; (ii) Foreign Contractor Tax election — a non-resident service provider or property manager may elect the 'deduction method' (net assessment on branch accounts approved by the GDT) instead of the deemed gross-receipts 'direct method' withholding regime; (iii) CIT incentive registration election — preferential CIT rates (e.g., 10% for 15 years and additional exemptions) are available only for projects in qualifying sectors (high-tech, socialized infrastructure, large-scale industrial parks), which a REIT's passive leasing and financial income ordinarily does not satisfy; (iv) Foreign tax credit election — unilateral credit for foreign taxes paid on foreign-source income, capped at the Vietnamese CIT rate, is available in lieu of treaty credit; (v) Loss-carryforward election — confirmed right to carry tax losses forward for 5 consecutive years (no carryback) under Article 9 of Decree 218/2013/ND-CP; (vi) Interest limitation and transfer-pricing rules — the 30% EBITDA interest-cap and the transfer-pricing documentation regime under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP apply, and Vietnam has not adopted BEPS Action 2 hybrid-mismatch rules, so no hybrid-mismatch election exists.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) — administered under the Law on Value Added Tax No. 48/2024/QH15 (effective 1 July 2025, replacing Law No. 13/2008/QH12) and Guiding Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC. The standard headline rate is 10%. A temporary 8% reduced rate regime under Government Resolution 174/2024/QH15 (extending the earlier Resolution 43/2022/QH15 program) applies to selected goods and services in the 10% category until 31 December 2025, but expressly excludes financial services, securities, insurance, and real-estate business; therefore the REIT's rental and property-trading income remains at 10%. For real-estate leasing, the full rental consideration is subject to VAT; for the transfer of land with attached assets, the tax base may be reduced by the legally recorded land-use-right cost in accordance with Article 7 of Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No statutory turnover threshold for incorporated taxpayers: each enterprise with an Enterprise Registration Certificate is automatically subject to VAT registration and periodic declaration, regardless of revenue or leasing turnover; failure to file a VAT registration dossier is separately sanctionable. For household and individual business taxpayers not incorporated as enterprises, annual revenue of VND 100,000,000 or less is exempt from VAT registration; above that threshold registration is mandatory. Foreign contractors performing in-Vietnam property-management or related services are subject to FCT registration and withholding with no de minimis threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing applies to all enterprises since 1 July 2022 under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP. Each e-invoice must be transmitted in XML format to the GDT's national e-invoice portal (https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn) within 24 hours of issuance. Newly established enterprises and high-risk taxpayers — a class that includes large B2B real-estate lessors and taxpayers with a history of VAT refund claims — must use invoices carrying a GDT-issued authorization code (mã của cơ quan thuế) obtained in real time per invoice. After 12 months of compliant filing, the taxpayer may elect to use self-issued invoice codes without pre-authorization but must continue to transmit invoice-issuance data in near-real time. The GDT mandates API (REST/Web-service) integration with the central e-invoice database for large-scale taxpayers, implemented for enterprises with annual revenue above approximately VND 300 billion and for all taxpayers seeking export-related VAT refunds; invoice data is automatically cross-checked against customs declarations (VNACCS/VCIS), bank payment reports, and the enterprise's tax returns. Failure to transmit or tampering with transmitted invoice data triggers automatic suspension of invoice issuance privileges.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rated VAT treatment is strictly limited under Article 9 of Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC and Article 10 of Law 48/2024/QH15 to: (i) goods physically exported from Vietnam, including goods sold to export-processing enterprises (EPEs), nontariff zones, and bonded warehouses; and (ii) export services supplied to foreign organizations or individuals that are physically performed and consumed wholly outside Vietnam. A REIT's domestic rental income is never zero-rated, even if the tenant is a foreign entity, because the real property is situated in Vietnam and the supply is consumed in Vietnam; such income is subject to VAT at 10%. Dividend, interest, and other portfolio financial income of the REIT is outside the VAT scope (exempt from VAT) rather than zero-rated. The LLC-REIT may validly claim 0% VAT only for genuinely offshore services, such as property-management, brokerage, or advisory services rendered to a foreign fund for assets located abroad, where the services are performed abroad, consumed abroad, invoiced to a non-resident, and settled in foreign currency, supported by the full documentary evidence set below.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs electronic export declaration (VNACCS/VCIS) bearing a lawful 'cleared' customs status, or for EPE/deemed-export supplies, the EPE-issued certificate and customs manifest
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill or equivalent international consignment documentation evidencing physical shipment from a Vietnamese port/airport to a destination outside Vietnam
Commercial invoice and the underlying export sales contract (or offshore service agreement) specifying Incoterms, applicable prices, and payment terms

Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) issued by a licensed Vietnamese commercial bank, or the foreign-currency account statement reflecting actual receipt of the foreign-currency proceeds from the overseas buyer into Vietnam within the applicable repatriation window
Packing list, customs weight certificate, and, where applicable, certificate of origin or processing certificate for goods exported from an EPE or bonded processing facility

For offshore services: the foreign customer's business registration or tax-identification certificate, a service-delivery/work-completion acceptance certificate, and independent documentation proving that the services were wholly performed and consumed outside Vietnam

The statutory state-budget refund request form (Form 01/ĐNHT under Circular 80/2021/TT-BTC) together with the corresponding e-invoice XML records transmitted to the GDT portal and the VAT refund computation worksheet
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Wrongfully claimed or fraudulent export zero-rating triggers: (i) retrospective reassessment for 5 years (extended to 10 years where fraud/evasion is established), re-collecting 10% output VAT on the affected consideration plus late-payment interest at 0.03% per day (approximately 10.95% per annum); (ii) administrative penalties under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP — a penalty equal to 20% of the under-collected tax for ordinary errors, rising to 1x, 2x, or 3x the under-declared or over-refunded amounts for intentional evasion, together with suspension of e-invoice self-issuance privileges for 12–24 months and forfeiture of expedited VAT-refund eligibility for repeat offenders; (iii) criminal liability under Articles 200 and 202 of the Penal Code 2015 (amended 2017) where the evaded tax or fraudulently obtained refund is VND 100 million or more — commercial legal entities may be fined up to VND 20 billion and suspended from operations for up to 3 years, and responsible directors, CFOs, or chief accountants face imprisonment (statutory scale extending to 10 years in aggravated organizational cases); (iv) clawback of any cash VAT refund already disbursed, with collection enforcement including bank-account freezes, asset seizure, and recovery of receivables under the Law on Tax Administration 38/2019/QH14; and (v) independent foreign-exchange-control penalties for failure to repatriate export proceeds within 180 days — administrative fines up to VND 500 million for legal entities — which the GDT treats as a red flag that the underlying export and its 0% VAT claim are not commercially genuine.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV; Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam), the sole central bank and principal foreign-exchange administration authority, acting through the Foreign Exchange Management Department and provincial branches. Core legal instruments include the Ordinance on Foreign Exchange No. 06/2005/PL-UBTVQH11, as amended by Ordinance No. 15/2013/UBTVQH13; Circular No. 05/2021/TT-NHNN (repatriation of export and current-transaction proceeds); Circular No. 09/2018/TT-NHNN (Direct Investment Capital Account – DICA); Circular No. 32/2015/TT-NHNN (foreign-exchange transactions between credit institutions and customers); and Circular No. 02/2021/TT-NHNN (external borrowing and repayment).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Viet Nam maintains current-account convertibility for registered trade, service, and investment-income transactions, while capital-account transactions remain selectively controlled and formalised through registration and purpose-code reporting. A foreign-invested LLC exercising REIT/trust activities is fully convertible on distributions once statutory tax filings are complete: profit remittance is permitted once per fiscal year, after CIT finalisation, submission of audited financial statements, payment of residual tax liabilities, and issuance of the tax authority's confirmation of profit remittance eligibility. The principal administrative hurdle is the mandatory ring-fencing of all inbound direct investment capital through a registered Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA); after funding, conversion of VND into USD/EUR for profit remittance, capital reduction, and liquidation proceeds is effectuated by an authorised bank without separate central-bank approval, provided the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) remains valid and the enterprise has filed all required balance-of-payments reports with the SBV.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Circular No. 05/2021/TT-NHNN, all export proceeds arising from current transactions must be repatriated into a foreign-currency payment account or DICA held with an SBV-licensed bank within 180 days from the date of completion of the export customs declaration. There is no ordinary-case mandatory conversion ratio into VND; however, the SBV may prescribe conversion obligations where expressly provided by statute, and any deferred repatriation requires prior written approval of the SBV. The enterprise must keep a reconciliation file matching each SWIFT credit to the applicable customs declaration, export contract, and commercial invoice, and must notify the bank of the purpose code 'export proceeds from sale of goods'.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Offshore digital EMIs and cross-border payment platforms (e.g., non-licensed digital banks and electronic-money institutions) cannot lawfully open local-currency corporate accounts, maintain DICA-equivalent facilities, or provide in-Viet-Nam deposit-taking services for a foreign-invested REIT LLC. Only credit institutions, foreign-bank branches, and licensed non-bank payment intermediaries authorised by the SBV under the Law on Credit Institutions may hold corporate funds or execute payment accounts. Offshore EMIs are permissible solely for ancillary pre-funding collection or as correspondents subject to per-transaction bank review; reliance on them for the REIT's core dividend-distribution and capital flows is inadvisable and may trigger AML breaches.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is the default requirement for corporate onboarding of a foreign-invested LLC: at least one legal representative of the LLC, or a fully authorised officer holding a notarised and apostilled power of attorney, must attend an in-person interview at the bank's head office or branch with original constitutional documents, certified copies of passports, and the original IRC/ERC certificate. Fully remote onboarding for foreign corporates is generally not accepted, although the SBV eKYC framework under Circular No. 02/2020/TT-NHNN may be used for pre-verification of resident individuals; the final board-approved sign-off for the REIT entity requires the documentary original and live interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque beneficial-ownership chain arising from an offshore-owned LLC structured as an investment trust/REIT, where trust certificates or economic-beneficiary information is not visible in the commercial registry.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete beneficial-ownership declaration (Form 02 under the Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 02/2022/QH15), the constitutive trust deed or REIT formation deed, register of unit/beneficial-interest holders, IRC and ERC, notarised and apostilled board resolutions, written source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements, and audited financial statements for the preceding two fiscal years.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payment-rail pattern consisting of regular dividend-distribution wires to foreign investors, which may be flagged as round-tripping or as distributions lacking operating substance from real-property holdings.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid IRC expressly covering the real-estate investment-trust scope, independent property-portfolio valuations, audited management accounts and statutory audit certificate, CIT finalisation certificates with proof of tax payment, board dividend-distribution resolutions, and a cash-flow model demonstrating that distributions are paid solely from after-tax distributable income derived from property income.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign-issued incorporation documents whose apostille/consular legalisation is incomplete or inconsistent with Vietnamese notarial practice, causing KYC rejection at account-opening stage.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Hague Apostille certificate plus Vietnamese consular legalisation where required, English-to-Vietnamese certified translations, parent-level bank statements evidencing clean provenance of capital, personal identity evidence for signing directors, and a sworn affidavit confirming genuineness of all corporate documentation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk-jurisdiction nexus, such as inbound remittances originating from a jurisdiction under FATF monitoring or a tax-haven jurisdiction, or cash-intensive counterparties in real-estate transactions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due-diligence file setting out the economic rationale of each transaction, commercial contracts and underlying property-chain title documentation, KYC file of the ultimate funding entity, confirmation that counterparties are licit and non-PEP, a compliance opinion of Vietnamese counsel, and regular transaction-level monitoring commitments.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound FDI equity and shareholder-loan capital must be remitted by SWIFT MT103 directly into the enterprise's Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) maintained with a licensed Vietnamese commercial bank, quoting in the wire narrative the full enterprise legal name, the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) number, the ERC number, and the standardized balance-of-payments purpose code 'Direct investment – capital contribution to enterprise'. Remittances should be sent with charges marked OUR to ensure full value is credited to the DICA. The bank then matches each credit to the registered capital schedule under Circular No. 09/2018/TT-NHNN and reports the transaction to the SBV within the statutory window; no drawdown is permitted until the incoming credit is validated against the IRC and the enterprise's capital-contribution schedule.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational outflows (construction costs, property-management fees, import of equipment and services) settle via SWIFT MT103 from the entity's VND or foreign-currency operating accounts, with each payment supported by an underlying invoice, customs import declaration where applicable, and the relevant BOP purpose code. For large purchases of land and building assets, a commercial letter of credit (SWIFT MT700) is used for construction, equipment, and completed-project disbursement. Distribution and profit-remittance wires are executed as SWIFT MT103 using purpose code 'remittance of profits to foreign investors', preceded by issuance of the tax-authority-approved profit-remittance notification and the bank's FX dealing confirmation; the corresponding debit to the DICA must be reported to the SBV.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forwards executed with an SBV-licensed credit institution, tenor capped at 365 days and strictly linked to underlying trade, service, or investment cashflows under Circular No. 32/2015/TT-NHNN
FX Swaps between VND and USD/EUR for managing cashflow timing mismatches on rental income and distribution dates
Cross-Currency Interest Rate Swaps (CCIRS) between the REIT and an authorised bank to hedge long-dated interest-rate and currency exposure on property-financing facilities
Spot FX transactions for immediate settlement of operating payments and ongoing dividend/conversion cycles

NDFs (Non-Deliverable Forwards) are not permitted onshore without an express SBV licence; offshore NDF access by the foreign parent is not enforceable as an onshore hedge and may not be documented as part of the Vietnamese REIT's treasury plan

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Operation Report (Báo cáo tình hình hoạt động doanh nghiệp) with audited financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the enterprise's registration jurisdiction under the Ministry of Planning and Investment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March, being within 90 days after the 31 December fiscal year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of VND 10,000,000–20,000,000 (approx. USD 400–800) for late or non-submission under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP; failure to file for more than 6 months after a written DPI reminder may trigger administrative strike-off of the Enterprise Registration Certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax (CIT) Finalization Return (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế thu nhập doanh nghiệp)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Sub-Department or Provincial Tax Office with jurisdiction over the DPI-registered head office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the 90th day from the fiscal year end, i.e. 31 March for calendar-year filers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Progressive late-filing fines of VND 4,000,000–30,000,000 (approx. USD 160–1,200) and late-payment interest of 0.03% per day on any finalization shortfall under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP; under-declaration additionally attracts a penalty of 1–3 times the evaded CIT amount.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business License Tax declaration and remittance (Lệ phí môn bài)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Office (Cục Thuế) through the taxpayer's managing sub-department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 30 January of the current year for the preceding calendar year; newly established LLCs must file within 30 days of enterprise registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or non-payment accrues interest at 0.03% per day and carries an administrative penalty up to VND 20,000,000 (approx. USD 800) under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP; persistent non-compliance is reported to DPI and may support deregistration proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Investment Project Implementation Report under Investment Law 2020 relating to the REIT license
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment / Investment Registration Authority that issued the Investment Registration Certificate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than 31 March annually, covering the preceding calendar year's project implementation status
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative penalties for failure to report or for misreporting project operation, including fines up to tens of millions of VND and potential suspension or revocation of the Investment Registration Certificate for repeated non-compliance, which may lead to administrative deregistration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited statutory financial statements (Báo cáo tài chính năm đã kiểm toán)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Office for the corporate income tax assessment and parallel copy to the Provincial DPI for foreign-invested enterprise monitoring
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year end (by 31 March), with the independent audit report issued by a licensed Vietnamese audit firm
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-submission or absence of the audit report invalidates the tax finalization package, attracts penalties up to VND 30,000,000 (approx. USD 1,200) under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP, and a continued 6-month non-compliance window may lead to enterprise strike-off by DPI.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory annual independent audit applies to all foreign-invested enterprises, including this 100% foreign-owned VN LLC, irrespective of revenue or asset size under Decree 17/2025/ND-CP; audit also applies to parent companies, public-interest entities, and securities-related funds; the REIT trust license additionally requires a fund-level annual audit under the securities and real estate fund regulations.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Statutory accounts must be prepared under Vietnam Accounting Standards (VAS) and the Vietnamese chart of accounts; IFRS may be used for group consolidated reporting upon Ministry of Planning and Investment approval; REIT-specific financial reporting must also cross-comply with Circular 99/2011/TT-BTC and applicable securities reporting circulars.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Law on Anti-Money Laundering 2022 and Decree 19/2023, the REIT LLC must identify and verify ultimate beneficial owners of every member or interest transfer, update the beneficial-ownership record within 7 working days of the transfer, and re-confirm the UBO profile at least annually when preparing the audited financial statements; any member or capital change must be notified to the business registration authority within 10 working days under Enterprise Law 2020.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Danh sách thành viên)
Register of Directors and Board of Members resolutions (Sổ biên bản Hội đồng thành viên)
Corporate Minute Book (Biên bản họp công ty)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350–1,200 per annum for registered office address, corporate secretarial services, and DPI handling in Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 6,000–18,000 per annum for a VAS-compliant independent audit of the REIT portfolio including property valuation and license compliance procedures
